info.title: flowd ML service
info.description:
**flowd ML service.** Day-one pretrained + rules models for the creator market, behind one FastAPI app.

Every response is explainable: a `model` block (name, version, stage), ordered `reasons` (plain English, with timecodes and
points), and ordered `fixes`. Scores are **checklist scores** until a learned model beats them on held-out apps
("Checklist score. It gets smarter as bounties settle.").

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <ML_API_KEY>` on every `/v1` route when a key is configured (always in production).
Money is integer cents; times are milliseconds from the first frame unless a field says otherwise.

frame_interval_ms.title: Frame Interval Ms
frame_interval_ms.description: Frame spacing inside the first 6 seconds (the hook). Later frames are sampled every 2 seconds.

include_embedding.title: Include Embedding
include_embedding.description: Return the embedding vector itself (large). Its model and size are always returned.

brief.description: The bounty brief. Without one, QA runs the brief-independent checks only.

format_id.title: Format Id
format_id.description: The Studio format the creator chose; inferred from the beats when omitted.

phash.title: Phash
phash.description: 16 hex characters: perceptual hash for duplicate detection.

AnalyzeVideoResponse.title: AnalyzeVideoResponse

median_lift_multiple.title: Median Lift Multiple
median_lift_multiple.description: Median of views / the creator's own median, so 1.0 is a typical post for that creator.

expected_multiplier.title: Expected Multiplier
expected_multiplier.description: What the band promises in Pay Math (CONSTANTS.scores.band_view_multiplier).

CalibrationBinOut.title: CalibrationBinOut
CalibrationBinOut.description: One band, realised: the contract's ``CalibrationBin`` plus how it compares with what the band promises.

predicted_points.title: Predicted Points
predicted_points.description: The score behind the band, when there is one; the band index is used otherwise.

monotone.title: Monotone
monotone.description: Realised lift never rises as the band falls (A >= B >= C >= D >= E, empty bands ignored).

spearman.title: Spearman
spearman.description: Mean within-app rank correlation of the score with realised lift.

top_vs_bottom.title: Top Vs Bottom
top_vs_bottom.description: Median lift of band A divided by band E (or the nearest populated bands).

drift_score.title: Drift Score
drift_score.description: Mean absolute gap between realised and promised multipliers, as a ratio.

CreatorPay.title: CreatorPay
CreatorPay.description: What a typical creator earns per video at the suggested CPM (Pay Math, an estimate).

vs_clearing_pct.title: Vs Clearing Pct
vs_clearing_pct.description: Price against the clearing CPM, in percent (+20 = 20% above).

all_in_cpm_cents.title: All In Cpm Cents
all_in_cpm_cents.description: What the brand pays per 1,000 verified views incl. fee and processing, when a budget is given.

value.title: Value
value.description: The metric that day (a ratio, e.g. trials per install).

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Denominator that day (installs for trial_rate, impressions for ctr, views for install_rate).

ref.title: Ref

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: What a flag points at (matches the contract's ``Evidence``): a timecode, a QA check, a brief line or a transcript line.

min_volume.title: Min Volume
min_volume.description: Days with less volume than this are too noisy to count.

drop_ratio.title: Drop Ratio
drop_ratio.description: 1 - current / peak. 0.30 or more triggers the alert.

target.title: Target
target.description: The item, signal or check this fixes.

gain.title: Gain

band_after.title: Band After
band_after.description: Band if only this fix is applied.

hook_points.title: Hook Points

moderation.title: Moderation

ScoreCard.title: ScoreCard
ScoreCard.description: A checklist score (contract ``ScoreCard``). Always labelled as a checklist score until a learned model ships.

t_ms.title: T Ms
t_ms.description: Where in the video this item was measured (ms), when it has a position.

target_ms.title: Target Ms
target_ms.description: The time the checklist wants it by (ms), when it has one.

ScoreItem.title: ScoreItem

predicted_lift_multiple.title: Predicted Lift Multiple

installs_per_1000_views.title: Installs Per 1000 Views

ViewsEstimate.title: ViewsEstimate
ViewsEstimate.description: Predicted views for this creator and band: median views x the band multiplier. Always an estimate.

bearerAuth.description: ML_API_KEY, sent by the flowd backend.
